Care instructions

Handle the model kit parts with care during assembly to avoid breakage. Use a soft cloth to clean dust from the assembled figure, avoiding water or harsh chemicals that could damage the plastic. Store the completed model away from direct sunlight to prevent color fading and keep it in a dust-free environment or display case to maintain its condition. For any movable joints, avoid forcing them beyond their intended range to preserve articulation.
